text:
Anya: Quick sync — we got a customer ask to ship a private VPC onprem pilot in Q3. Need cross-team alignment: scope, launch criteria, and what blocks runtime/infra/security. Who can triage?
Mike: I can take runtime/eng sequencing. Do we have a concrete feature list from sales? link to spec?
Anya: Sales shared a short checklist: data isolation (VPC + KMS), audit logs, model pinning, and predictable 99th p99 latency under 300ms for chat. They also want a canary rollout + rollback policy.
Srinivas: For p99 300ms, we need to pick a model variant (quantized vs fp16) and a dedicated pool size. Also need KV cache behavior clarified (session lengths, max tokens). Can you confirm expected QPS?
Anya: Customer estimates ~10 qps steady, spikes to 30 qps for a few mins. Sessions average 600 tokens. They will require SLA for latency during business hours.
Jade: Infra needs to know region/networking constraints. Onprem packaging will require our private control plane + a connector. We also need to size GPUs and plan for autoscaling/burst capacity. Any compliance constraints on data egress?
Li: Security: KMS integration + HSM option requested. We must run our infra-security checklist and threat model. Need timeline for customer review — they want FedRAMP-like controls but starting with SOC2 plus extra logging.
Olivia: Ops: we'll own runbook + oncall for the pilot. Need to know rollback criteria and who has escalation rights. Also confirm retention windows for logs (30/90/365 days?)
Mike: Proposing minimal runtime work: 1) add model-variant profile for quantized Llama-2-variant tuned for p99 SLA; 2) expose per-tenant routing policy to pin to dedicated pool; 3) improve KV cache eviction for long sessions. Estimate: 3 sprints (6 weeks) with 2 engs.
Srinivas: Sounds right. We also need a validation harness to simulate session spikes and token distributions. I'll mock a load script: ``loadtest --qps 30 --session-length 600 --concurrency 50``
Anya: Launch criteria (draft): 1) end-to-end private deploy tested in staging; 2) security review signed off; 3) runtime p99 <= 300ms under customer profile; 4) automated rollback on error rate > 2%; 5) runbooks + SRE oncall assigned.
Jade: Infra checklist items: networking diagram, IP allowlist, KMS integration docs, storage encryption at rest, sizing plan. We'll need VR/ops seat for install. ETA: 4 weeks for packaging + deployment automation with 2 infra engineers.
Li: Security items: threat model + attack surface doc, KMS/HSM proof-of-concept, audit log schema, retention policy, and pen-test schedule. I can start review next Monday. Need product to lock scope by end of week.
Olivia: Runbook items: playbooks for degraded throughput, model fallback, data ingestion errors, and cost-monitoring alerts. Can we get the expected cost per 1k tokens estimate so finances can prep billing options?
Anya: Good call. Finance wants a floor. Product: can you add cost blockers? Also we should decide whether to offer model quantization as a toggle for the customer or handle it on our side.
Mike: Prefer we manage quantization as a runtime knob — less user error. We'll surface a "performance profile" for the customer. Implementation note: profiles map to kernel configs + batching window settings.
Srinivas: I'll draft a performance-profile matrix: ``{name: 'fast', model: 'llm-q8', batch_window: 20ms, expected_p99: 260ms}`` and a fallback to 'safe' which is fp16 with higher cost but more stable outputs.
Anya: Action items: - Product (Anya) finalize scope doc w/ sales by Fri - Runtime (Mike + Srinivas) produce perf matrix + load harness by next Wed - Infra (Jade) sizing + packaging ETA in 1 week - Security (Li) start checklist next Mon - Ops (Olivia) draft runbooks
Jade: One more dependency: we need a dedicated infra ticket for private-control-plane cert rotation and connector docs. I'll open it and tag eng-infra.
Li: I'll flag any blockers in the ticket and add a security label. If anything looks risky, we escalate to PM/sales immediately.
deploy-bot: Pipeline update: #private-deploy-pkg build succeeded (artifact id: a1b2c3). Deployed to staging cluster-canary-03.
Srinivas: Nice. Once the artifact is on staging I can run the simulated workload and post results. If p99 spikes > 300ms we'll iterate on batching and model profile.
Anya: Thanks all — I'll set up a short sync Monday to confirm the scope lock. If anyone needs pre-read, I'll drop the doc here: https://redwood.internal/product/private-pilot-scope
Mike: 👍 will review perf requirements tonight.
Olivia: Adding runbook template to the doc now. ✅
Li: I'll add security checklist items by COB Monday.
Anya: Great — closing thread for actioning. Ping me if anything changes.
